intro.zh: 环氧中涂与各类底漆配套使用，可作嵌缝填补材料、环氧树脂腻子、自流平中涂、中层砂浆漆及彩砂压砂树脂，提高地坪系统的厚度、强度、载重及耐冲击性。
intro.en: Epoxy midcoats are used over primers as crack filler, epoxy putty, self-leveling midcoat, mortar midcoat and binder for broadcast colored sand, increasing the thickness, strength, load capacity and impact resistance of the flooring system.

summary.zh: 无溶剂型环氧中涂（A组份 BATOV-2001）与配套环氧中涂固化剂（B组份 BATOV-G201）是一种双组分、无溶剂、可厚涂的环氧树脂地坪涂料。与各类底漆配套使用，可作为嵌缝填补材料、环氧树脂腻子（配粉）、自流平中涂漆以及中层砂浆漆（配石英砂），可提高整个地坪涂装系统的厚度、强度、载重及耐冲击性；同时作彩砂地坪压砂用的树脂，具有较高的耐冲击性以及粘结强度。
summary.en: Solvent-free epoxy midcoat (Part A BATOV-2001) with epoxy midcoat hardener (Part B BATOV-G201) is a two-component, solvent-free, high-build epoxy flooring coating. Used over primers, it can serve as crack filler, epoxy putty (with powder), self-leveling midcoat or mortar midcoat (with quartz sand), increasing system thickness, strength, load capacity and impact resistance; also as the resin for broadcast colored-sand floors, with high impact resistance and bond strength.

uses.zh: 适用于地坪涂装系统中的中涂找平层、砂浆层、压砂层、透明面漆层等，作为油漆粘结料使用
uses.en: Used as binder in flooring systems for the midcoat leveling layer, mortar layer, broadcast-sand layer and clear topcoat layer

zh: 对底材、底漆的附着力高
作为砂浆粘结料的抗压强度高
与环氧面漆的粘结力高
作为压砂的粘接料，强度非常高
en: High adhesion to substrate and primer
High compressive strength as a mortar binder
Very high strength as a binder for broadcast sand

packaging.en: Part A 20 kg pail, Part B 5 kg pail (steel drums)

v.zh: 颜色一致，平整光滑
v.en: Uniform color, smooth and flat

v.en: No cracking or peeling

v.en: Note: pot life 25 min at 25 °C; shorter at higher temperatures

v.zh: 6h
v.en: 6 h

v.en: Min 24 h, max 36 h

v.en: Thinner BATOV-X001 (topcoat thinner) may be added

v.zh: BATOV-X001（面漆稀释剂）
v.en: BATOV-X001 (topcoat thinner)

v.zh: 刮刀披刮或馒刀馒涂（抹涂）。素地平整、光滑、强度好时可加入适量石英砂或石英粉，用刮刀披刮；素地基面坑洼或要求地坪结构有指定厚度时，加入适量石英砂馒涂
v.en: Squeegee/trowel application or trowelling. On flat, smooth, strong substrates, add suitable quartz sand or quartz powder and apply with a squeegee; on pitted substrates or where a specified thickness is required, add suitable quartz sand and trowel

v.zh: 5～35℃；基面温度至少高于空气露点温度 3℃ 以上；环境温度高于 35℃ 一般不建议施工
v.en: 5–35 °C; substrate at least 3 °C above dew point; application above 35 °C generally not recommended

v.zh: 应确保施工场所通风无尘，但不应有强风，以免带进灰尘影响表观效果
v.en: Keep the area ventilated and dust-free, without strong wind that blows in dust and spoils the finish

v.zh: 干燥时间在标准条件（25℃，60% 湿度）下测定，仅供参考；不同温度和湿度下差异较大，还受漆膜厚度、通风状况、下层涂料等影响。温度升高干燥时间缩短，温度降低则加长
v.en: Drying times measured at 25 °C, 60% RH, for reference only; they vary with temperature, humidity, film thickness, ventilation and substrate coating (shorter when warmer, longer when colder)

v.zh: 涂料密封储存在干燥、阴凉、通风良好的条件，避免高温和火源；运输时保证车厢环境干燥、封闭，材料码放平稳
v.en: Store sealed in a dry, cool, well-ventilated place away from heat and fire; keep the vehicle dry and enclosed in transit and stack stably

v.zh: A组份 BATOV-2001 : B组份 BATOV-G201 = 4:1，混合后充分搅拌均匀
v.en: Part A BATOV-2001 : Part B BATOV-G201 = 4:1; mix thoroughly

v.zh: 技术参数表为实干 ＞24 h，施工参数表为 24 h
v.en: Spec table gives hard-dry ＞24 h; application table gives 24 h

summary.zh: 纯树脂环氧中涂（A组份 BATOV-2002）是以环氧树脂为主、含少量助剂的双组分纯环氧树脂中涂材料，与配套环氧底漆固化剂（B组份 BATOV-G202）使用。与各类底漆配套使用，可作为嵌缝填补材料、环氧树脂腻子（配粉）、自流平中涂漆以及中层砂浆漆（配石英砂），可提高整个地坪涂装系统的厚度、强度、载重及耐冲击性；同时作彩砂地坪压砂用的树脂，具有较高的耐冲击性以及粘结强度。
summary.en: Pure-resin epoxy midcoat (Part A BATOV-2002) is a two-component epoxy resin midcoat with few additives, used with epoxy primer hardener (Part B BATOV-G202). Used over primers, it can serve as crack filler, epoxy putty (with powder), self-leveling midcoat or mortar midcoat (with quartz sand), increasing system thickness, strength, load capacity and impact resistance; also as the resin for broadcast colored-sand floors, with high impact resistance and bond strength.

uses.zh: 适用于地坪涂装系统中的中涂找平层、砂浆层、压砂层、透明面漆层等，作为油漆粘结料使用
uses.en: Used as binder in flooring systems for the midcoat leveling layer, mortar layer, broadcast-sand layer and clear topcoat layer

可与石英砂混合馒涂，效果好
en: High adhesion to substrate and primer
High compressive strength as a mortar binder
Very high strength as a binder for broadcast sand
Mixes well with quartz sand for trowelling
